title: Double Drip Berry Blitz Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: The Berry Blitz Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid from Double Drip is a deeply delicious fusion of seven delectable berries. In each puff you can experience the rich, sweet tang of freshly-picked forest berries, tart blackcurrants and soft, succulent strawberries, all in one super-smooth and utterly irresistible Nic Salt E-Liquid from the legendary Double Drip range. This Double Drip Nic Salt 50VG/50PG blend provides the perfect balance of flavour and cloud production . T he specially crafted nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarettes , starter vape kits and pod vape devices. It’s the p erfect e-juice option for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate, satisfying nicotine relief and a smooth throat hit provided by premium N ic S alts . Unlike regular freebase E-L iquids, nicotine salt ’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine . Whilst delivering a smoother throat hit than higher-strength freebase liquids are capable of. With nicotine salt E-L iquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic S alt E-L iquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic S alts . If you love this Double Drip Nic Salt E-Liquid flavour then you are bound to enjoy others from the range . This e-juice range has lots of flavours available to suit all kinds of vaping needs, wants and desires. From classic fruit flavours to sweet bubbly drinks , you can be sure to find a Nic Salt flavour that suits your vaping needs.
